Privacy

Your information

Privacy information

Reading and reflection

The learning pages require no account, booking, or submission. The reflection prompts do not collect or store your answers. If you choose to write, use your own notebook or a tool of your choice.

Question finder

The question finder filters answers in your browser. Its text is not saved, placed in the URL, sent to a model, or included in analytics events by this tool. It is not a live AI conversation. General website analytics still operate as described below.

Information you choose to send

Mind Clarity receives information you choose to share by email or WhatsApp. Please do not send card numbers, bank details, OTPs, or passwords.

Analytics

This website uses Google Analytics to understand general visitor activity. It is not used to provide medical or psychological profiling.

Optional payments

Payments for optional conversations are processed by Razorpay. Mind Clarity does not request or store your full payment credentials.

Questions

For privacy questions, contact pudaykumar12@gmail.com.
